headline: JSW Steel CEO Flags Surge in Chinese Steel Imports and Trade Barriers
summary: The CEO of JSW Steel cautioned that India's domestic market is struggling with a surge of cheap steel imports from China, prompting calls for stronger protective trade measures.
why: JSW Steel is one of India's largest primary steelmakers; India is the world's second-largest crude steel producer.

impacts.name: Indian Steel Industry
impacts.why: Inflow of cheaper Chinese steel exports depresses local pricing power and margins for Indian producers.
